verdict.rationale: Rippling documents paying employees and contractors from its payroll system "without waiting on transfers or conversion" (global payroll), and community discussion mentions electronic payouts routed through banking partners. This implies non-check electronic pay, but direct deposit is never named and no next-day or 2-day funding timeline is stated. missing for 10: explicit direct-deposit documentation, a stated next-day/2-day deposit speed for US payroll, independent or hands-on corroboration of deposit timing.
